title: Real Estate Service Contracts: First Settlement Payment Amount
content:
**Clause.** The first settlement payment on a failed-sale charge of a Real Estate Service Contracts listing order is worked out from the order's billing history.

1. The open failed-sale balance is the failed-sale charges billed on the order less the payments the seller has already made on the order.
2. The seller pays the open failed-sale balance in full as the first settlement payment, rounded to the cent.

## Records

| Quantity | Record |
|---|---|
| Failed-sale charges billed | the failed-sale charge invoices in the order's billing history |
| Payments the seller has already made | the payments in the order's billing history whose payer is the seller |

## Worked examples (hypothetical orders)

- A failed-sale charge of $412.50 and no seller payment on the order: open failed-sale balance $412.50; first settlement payment **$412.50**.
- A failed-sale charge of $640.00 and an earlier seller payment of $200.00 on the order: open failed-sale balance $440.00; first settlement payment **$440.00**.
- Payments made on the order by escrow or by the buyer are not payments the seller has made, and leave the open failed-sale balance unchanged.
